text:
aisha: Heads-up: scheduling prod deploy tonight 02:00 UTC for ff.optimizer.v2. Ramp plan: 0.5% -> 5% (10m) -> 25% (10m) -> 100% (10m). No DB migrations. Adding canary cohort and kill-switch. Will post deploy links and the rollout policy.

deploy-bot: :calendar: Deployment scheduled: job id 20260320-ff-opt-v2. Runbook attached. Commands available: `/deploy start 20260320-ff-opt-v2` and `/deploy abort 20260320-ff-opt-v2`.

tom: Quick ask — please pin runtime to `v2-rc3` on dedicated nodes. If we need to fallback to quantized variant it requires rebuild, so prefer runtime pinning.

marco: Abort criteria proposal: error_rate > 2% sustained for 5m OR p99 latency > baseline * 1.30 for 5m. On abort: automatically revert affected cohorts to `ff.optimizer.v1` and notify on-call.

sanjay: Confirmed no schema/migration. Logs will stream to stackdriver/optimizer-prod. I'm prepping log filters for any GPU OOMs.

release-eng: Release notes snippet draft: "ff.optimizer.v2: improved batching heuristics and KV-cache reuse. Known: initial warmup latency on cold GPUs for seq>1024; canary rollout planned." Will post full notes after smoke run.

aisha: Ack. Canary targets: p50 <= 60ms, p95 <= 220ms, errors < 1%. I'll monitor the dashboard during each step.

deploy-bot: Deployment started: cohort 0.5% -> observing. Live dashboard: https://dash.prod/redwood/deploy/20260320-ff-opt-v2

deploy-bot: Canary metrics @0.5%: p95=160ms (+35%), errors=0.8% — within thresholds. Proceeding to 5% per plan.

aisha: Hold at 5% for 15m before moving to 25%. want another stability window. @tom @marco any objections?

tom: No objections, agree to hold extra 10m.

[10m later]

deploy-bot: Canary update @5%: p95 spiked to 380ms (+114%), errors rose to 3.6% — abort rule triggered. See events: `latency-spike`, `error-rate-threshold`.

marco: Initiating rollback for affected cohorts. Command: `!feature-flag toggle ff.optimizer.v2 off --cohort 5% --reason "latency spike"` — executing now.

deploy-bot: Rollback executed: ff.optimizer.v2 toggled OFF for cohorts 0.5% and 5%. Traffic reverted to ff.optimizer.v1. Notifying on-call and pausing further rollout jobs.

sanjay: Collecting logs from affected pods: `kubectl logs -l app=optimizer -n prod --since=15m` and capturing perf traces. Saving traces to gs://redwood-prod-traces/20260320-ff-opt-v2/

aisha: Filing action item: extend initial canary to 30m next run and add explicit warmup step to pre-load KV cache on cold GPUs. I'll update the rollout doc and schedule warmup job.

release-eng: I'll update release notes: "v2 rollout paused due to latency regressions on cold GPUs; engineering to add warmup and retry logic before reattempt." Will send a short customer-facing blurb after review.

aisha: :rotating_light: Short post-deploy review required — scheduling deep dive tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Thanks everyone for rapid response. :thumbsup:
